mixed.text: {hero} {action}, then a second set of tracks crosses the first one. The otter has doubled back, leaving the flat rock empty ahead.
mixed.carry: The otter has circled back toward the first camera.

better.text: {hero} {action}, just like {friend} said, and the tracks end at a reed patch with the otter in plain sight. A fish sits on the flat rock.
better.carry: The otter leaves one fish on the flat rock.

acts.situation: The otter waits by a reed patch upstream, and a fallen branch blocks the creek path downstream.
acts.goal: Clear the fallen branch from the creek
acts.twist: A camera blink makes the otter splash and scatter loose sticks.

worse.text: {hero} {action}, and the branch rolls against a blinking camera. The otter splashes hard, sending loose sticks into three new piles downstream.
worse.carry: A spray of sticks blocks the creek in three places.

mixed.text: {hero} {action}, and the branch moves halfway before a camera blinks. The otter splashes once, scattering loose sticks across the creek path.
mixed.carry: Loose sticks now dot the path to the bank.

better.text: {hero} {action}, on {friend}'s advice, and the whole branch slides onto the bank in one piece. Clear water runs straight toward the sheltered bank downstream.
better.carry: The clear creek runs straight to the sheltered bank.

acts.situation: News of the otter has spread, and quiet visitors crowd the small bridge for a look downstream.
acts.goal: Welcome the otter home to stay
acts.twist: Every visitor camera blinks together when the otter shows a whisker.

worse.text: {hero} {action}, and every visitor camera blinks together at one whisker. The otter ducks under the bridge, where the crowd noise bounces off the water.
worse.carry: The otter waits under the bridge, out of sight.

mixed.text: {hero} {action}, and half the bridge crowd lowers their cameras in time. The otter stops below the rest, whiskers up, waiting for quiet.
mixed.carry: The otter pauses below a row of lowered cameras.

better.text: {hero} {action}, {friend} called it, and the crowd lowers every camera at once. The otter swims under the bridge and circles the sheltered bank.
better.carry: The otter picks the sheltered bank below the bridge.

callbacks: It blinked again.
A fern shade calms the otter.
A fish left on the flat rock.

cast.line: The camera blinked again. I swear it posed.

mostly_fine.text: {hero} {action}, and the group gets the otter settled below the bridge for good. Every camera on the creek now wears a fern shade, so each photo has one green hat.

triumph.text: {hero} {action}, and the whole group watches the otter slide into the sheltered bank for good. Rosa checks the last camera and finds him posed beside his fish.
triumph.line: The otter lives by the creek now.

well_its_a_story.text: {hero} {action}, and the otter moves in under the bridge where the whole group can wave each morning. The shy swimmer now poses daily, strictly on his own schedule.
well_its_a_story.line: The otter runs the morning photo stop now.

finale.situation: The otter circles a sheltered bank below the bridge, and every camera along the creek points his way.
finale.goal: Help the otter settle in the creek
finale.twist: The otter settles only where no camera blink can reach him.

problem.name: The Camera Shy Otter
problem.rule: The otter hides whenever a trail camera blinks at him.
problem.stakes: He leaves the creek for good if he gets scared.

bible.setting: Staff check trail cameras along a narrow creek in an ocean side nature park near a farm town. A shy river otter is back after many years, and every camera blink sends him under the ferns.

opener.title: The Wiggly Bridge Back
opener.teaser: A new bridge opens at sunrise, but it keeps wiggling like something underneath is breathing.
opener.narration: Drivers, a road crew, and an inspector gather on a small town road where a brand-new bridge opens at sunrise after a long closure. The new bridge was built on the shell of a giant sleepy turtle, and each breath he takes lifts the road up and down. If the road still wiggles at sunrise inspection, the bridge fails and the town stays cut off.
opener.goal: Keep the turtle still until the sunrise inspection
opener.situation: Orange barriers, a fresh gray road that gently rises and falls, and a huge sleepy eye blinking under the edge.

problem.name: The Sleepy Bridge Turtle
problem.stakes: the bridge fails and the town stays cut off

threat.name: The Sleepy Bridge Turtle
threat.want: the bridge fails and the town stays cut off

beats: Find what lifts the new road
Calm the turtle under the bridge
Keep the road still overnight
Pass the sunrise inspection

real_setting.place_type: a small town road with a closed bridge
real_setting.situation: a road closed for a long time is about to reopen with a newly built bridge
real_setting.stakes: if it fails inspection, the town stays cut off
arc: The old bridge wears out and closes
Drivers take long detours for a long time
A crew builds a new bridge
The new bridge passes inspection and opens

npc_line.speaker: Bridge inspector
npc_line.line: Did the road just breathe, or did I skip breakfast?

ending_facts.official_line: A road in Porter, Indiana that was closed for nearly 3 years will reopen with a new bridge.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: Local drivers will get the road back after a long closure with detours.
ending_facts.headline: Road with new bridge in Porter to reopen after nearly 3 years

acts.situation: Orange barriers, a fresh gray road that gently rises and falls, and a huge sleepy eye blinking under the edge.
acts.goal: Find what lifts the new road
acts.twist: Idling truck engines make the turtle breathe faster.

worse.text: {hero} {action}, and the road tips enough to roll every orange cone into the ditch. Rosa catches one cone before it lands on the turtle nose.
worse.carry: Orange cones are scattered in the ditch.

mixed.text: {hero} {action}, so the eye opens wide and looks straight at the idling trucks. Each quick breath lifts the front wheels an inch off the pavement.
mixed.carry: The turtle breathes faster near idling engines.

better.text: {hero} {action}, {friend}'s idea, and the eye turns from the trucks toward the quiet barriers. The road settles into a slow, even rise and fall.
better.carry: Engines off, the road rises slow and even.

acts.situation: The turtle eye stays open under the road, and Rosa watches each slow rise from the orange barriers.
acts.goal: Calm the turtle under the bridge
acts.twist: One short honk makes the turtle breath jump.

worse.text: {hero} {action}, but the turtle breathes out hard and blows Rosa clipboard under a barrier. Drivers bounce in their seats as the road drops.
worse.carry: Rosa has no clipboard for the night watch.

mixed.text: {hero} {action}, and the turtle slows for ten breaths before a driver honks from the back. The road hops once, neat as a hiccup.
mixed.carry: The road stays calm unless a horn sounds.

better.text: {hero} {action}, just like {friend} said, and the turtle eye half closes in the shade. Each breath comes slower, and the cones stop rolling.
better.carry: Slow breaths mean the cones stay put.

acts.situation: Night covers the closed road, and white breath puffs rise past Rosa at the barriers.
acts.goal: Hold the road flat till morning
acts.twist: Cold night air turns each breath into a white puff.

worse.text: {hero} {action}, then one long breath lifts the road until the barriers slide six feet toward town. Rosa marks the new spot with a cone.
worse.carry: The barriers now sit six feet closer to town.

mixed.text: {hero} {action}, and the road stays flat until white puffs show faster breaths near midnight. The barriers creep, but no truck crosses the bridge yet.
mixed.carry: White puffs show faster breaths near midnight.

better.text: {hero} {action}, on {friend}'s advice, and the white puffs space out into a steady rhythm. A cone on the center line barely moves all night.
better.carry: Steady breath puffs mark a calm night rhythm.

acts.situation: Sunrise lights the barriers, and Rosa steps onto the road with her clipboard while drivers wait behind her.
acts.goal: Walk Rosa across the bridge slowly
acts.twist: At sunrise the turtle takes one deep morning breath.

worse.text: {hero} {action}, and the morning breath lifts Rosa clipboard high enough to catch the wind. Her checklist lands at the far barriers, past the turtle eye.
worse.carry: Rosa checklist waits beyond the far barriers.

mixed.text: {hero} {action}, so Rosa reaches the middle as the road rises under her shoes. She rides it down flat, clipboard still dry in her hand.
mixed.carry: Rosa reaches mid bridge as sunrise nears.

better.text: {hero} {action}, {friend} called it, and Rosa crosses on the flat part between breaths. Drivers line up quietly behind the barriers, engines off.
better.carry: Drivers wait quietly with engines off.

callbacks: Rosa asks if the road breathed before breakfast.
Orange cones roll whenever the road tips.
White breath puffs show the turtle pace at night.

mostly_fine.text: {hero} {action}, and every hero helps Rosa open the barriers for good. The center cone stays stuck on the shell, waving at each passing truck.
mostly_fine.line: The bridge is open, and one cone commutes daily.

triumph.text: {hero} {action}, and the whole group crosses as Rosa waves the first drivers through. The road rises once, gentle and slow, and nobody spills a coffee.
triumph.line: Rosa finally gets breakfast, and the road gets traffic.

well_its_a_story.text: {hero} {action}, and the group opens the road while the turtle keeps its slow wiggle. Drivers cross at walking pace and wave, because the town likes the ride.
well_its_a_story.line: The bridge still breathes, just under a speed limit.

finale.situation: The road gives one long rise at sunrise, and Rosa stands mid bridge with every driver watching.
finale.goal: Keep the turtle still until the sunrise inspection
finale.twist: The turtle holds still when every engine stays off.

problem.name: The Sleepy Bridge Turtle
problem.rule: The road rises and falls with every breath the turtle takes under it.
problem.stakes: the bridge fails and the town stays cut off

bible.setting: A small town road waits behind orange barriers for a new bridge to open at sunrise. The fresh road rests on a giant turtle, and each breath lifts it gently.
